agents.source: AI participant, one new process per participant, sees only its own prompt and its own earlier answers

scriptedRoleJustification: None: the paper describes no confederates, experimenters or pre-recorded participants.
samplingUnit: n = number of AI participants per slate; each completes the whole slate once
assignmentUnit: participant, per effect (random assignment per effect assumed; see issues iss-assign-slate1 and iss-assign-slate2)
observationUnit: one participant's responses to one effect
order: effects in a fully randomized order per participant (paper); the slate's individual-difference and demographic items follow, as in the paper
visibility: A participant sees only its own earlier pages and answers in the session; nothing from other participants.

imageEffects.huan: The response is a click on the map picture, so a participant must be able to see the picture and reply with a position; the codebook gives no reply format for it.
imageEffects.geis: The manipulation is the length of the line in the organization chart picture, which a text-only participant cannot see.
imageEffects.haus34: Both scenarios are to be read using the diagram as a resource; the diagram is a picture.
imageEffects.nore: Every item is a picture of two groups of objects and a test object.
imageEffects.gray: The adult and baby identities of Sam and Roger are shown only in the photographs.
